title: Incorrect index reset in `Fenwick tree` after full withdrawal
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  When a user adds liquidity to the pool, the system triggers the `_updateLockData` function, which in turn calls the `Fenwicks._deposit` function to record the deposit amount and its associated lock duration (e.g., 7 days).
